week34.0: Umwana, wakubise kubera kubura umwanya, mu rusangi akomeza kuzinga amaguru ayajanisha mu gituza mu gihe akomeza kugenda buri gihe.
week34.3: Naho umwanya wagabanutse, ingendo z’umwana n’ishusho y’inda yawe ihinduka mu rusangi biguma bigaragara.
week34.4: Gukomeza kwitegereza ingendo z’umwana zisanzwe biguma ari ngombwa kugeza ku ivuka.

week35.0: Umwana akomeza kwiyongera, ibizamufasha kugenzura ubushuhe bw’umubiri igihe avutse. Umwanya uboneka mu nda y’umwana uragenda uba muto.
week35.3: Igitutu c’ikibuno kigaragara cane gishobora kuboneka uko umwana amanuka buhoro buhoro.
week35.4: Naho umwanya ari muto, umwana akwiye gukomeza kugenda ku buryo busa n’ubw’ibyumweru vyabanje.

week36.0: Ibihaha mu rusangi byarakuze bihagije kugira umwana ahumeke ubwiwe, kandi umwana ashobora konka no gusya ivyo yariye.
week36.3: Rimwe na rimwe ushobora kumva ubuze umwuka, kuko inda y’umwana ifata umwanya munini munsi y’imbavu.
week36.4: Inda ibonwa nk’iyuzuye hagati y’icumweru ca 37 n’ica 42.

week37.0: Umwana abonwa nk’umaze gukura bihagije kugira avuke. Abana benshi cane ubu bicaye umutwe ujanye hasi.
week37.3: Kwumva igitutu c’ikibuno kigenda cyiyongera ni ibisanzwe uko umwana yinjira mu kibuno.
week37.4: Kuva kuri iki cumweru, inda ibonwa nk’iyuzuye kandi ivuka rishobora kuba igihe cose.

week38.0: Umusatsi muto wapfutse uruhu wamaze gushira cane, kandi amara arakusanya meconium, ikibyimba ca mbere c’uruyoya.
week38.3: Kumenyera ibimenyetso vy’ibise bishobora kugufasha uko ivuka riregereza.
week38.4: Ivuka ryateguwe, iyo ritagize impamvu y’abaganga, mu rusangi ntirigirwa inama imbere y’icumweru ca 39.

week39.0: Uruhu, rwari ruto kuruta, rwarabyimbye kandi ubu rurinda umwana neza. Agapfunyika karinda, vernix, kandi korohereza inzira ye mu gihe c’ivuka.
week39.3: Kudashobora gutegereza no kunanirwa gatoya ni ibisanzwe uko itariki yo kubyara yegereza.
week39.4: Gutembera kw’amaraso y’uruyoya gukomeza kwimenyereza nyuma gato y’ivuka, ibishobora kuguma gutuma amaboko canke ibirenge bigira ibara ry’ubururu bworoheje mu kanya gato.

week40.0: Umwana yamaze gukura rwose kandi yiteguye kuvuka. Itariki yo kubyara ni igereranyo: ivuka ryinshi riba mu minsi izengurutse iyo tariki, imbere canke inyuma yayo.
week40.3: Gutegereza ibimenyetso vy’ibise (ibikoma bihoraho, amazi y’inda asenyutse) ni ibisanzwe muri iki gihe.
week40.4: Kurenza gatoya itariki yo kubyara biracari bisanzwe kandi ntibisobanura ko hari ikibazo; gukurikiranwa cane mu rusangi kuratangwa.

week41.0: Umwana aracari yarakuze rwose. Inyuma y’itariki yo kubyara, gukurikiranwa cane mu rusangi kuratangwa kugira harebwe amagara y’umwana.
week41.1: Gutegereza igihe kirekire bishobora kujana n’umunaniro n’ukudashobora gutegereza kwiyongereye.
week41.2: Kurenza igihe c’inda mu rusangi bitera ko itsinda ry’abaganga rikurikirana cane.
